merchantId.description: Business to open the session against

secret.description: Signing secret, shown once at creation
New signing secret, shown once upon rotation
Raw secret, shown once at creation

codAmountMinor.description: Money as integer minor units. A decimal here is a bug, not a convenience.

replayed.description: True when request was replayed via Idempotency-Key

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null on the last page

hasMore.description: True when more rows exist past this page

collectedMinor.description: Integer minor units. A decimal here is a bug, not a convenience.

expectedMinor.description: Expected COD amount in minor units (poisha)

collectedMinor.description: Collected COD amount in minor units (poisha)

shortfallMinor.description: Shortfall: expected - collected, 0 when fully collected

replayed.description: True when request was replayed via Idempotency-Key

deviceSequence.description: The device's own monotonic counter. With `createdAt` it forms the dedupe key and the order.

createdAt.description: The device's clock. Deliberately not the server's — the server cannot know when it was pressed.

expectedState.description:
What the device believed at the time. `{ status }` for a command about the rider,
`{ shipmentId, shipmentStatus }` for one about a parcel — the latter is what lets the server
reject a scan of something that was cancelled while the phone was in a pocket.

recordedAt.description: The device's clock. A stale ping is refused by the service rather than applied.

replayed.description: True when request was replayed via Idempotency-Key
True when request was replayed via Idempotency-Key

collectedMinor.description: Integer minor units collected at the door. A decimal here is a bug, not a convenience.

code.description: Plaintext OTP returned once and never stored
Exactly OTP_LENGTH digits. Anything else is a wrong guess, not a malformed request.

photoBase64.description: Raw base64, no data: prefix — the client encodes the bytes and sends them.

latitude.description: Where the parcel was handed over. Checked against Bangladesh, not trusted as a number.

replayed.description: True when request was replayed via Idempotency-Key

direction.description: 1 for credit (owed to merchant), -1 for debit (owed by merchant)

amountMinor.description: Sum of entries of this type in minor units

entries.description: How many ledger rows made up this line

balanceMinor.description: Signed minor units: negative means owed to merchant

currency.description: Null when no COD was recorded that day

expectedMinor.description: Expected COD in minor units (poisha), as a string

collectedMinor.description: Collected COD in minor units (poisha), as a string

settledMinor.description: Settled COD in minor units (poisha), as a string
